elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: The clause states a USD 2,000,000 primary limit but does not specify a per-occurrence limit.

elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: The clause states a USD 2,000,000 primary limit but does not specify an aggregate limit.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Professional Liability (Errors and Omissions) Insurance is required only in the amount of USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause requires only USD 2,000,000 of Cyber and Privacy Liability Insurance. The operative language does not demonstrate that M&I does not process Customer Data, so the condition cannot be treated as absent.

elements.element: Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
elements.evidence: M&I must maintain Workers' Compensation Insurance throughout the Term at its own expense, as mandated or allowed by the state where the Services are performed.

elements.element: Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: M&I must deliver original Certificates of Insurance annually at Customer's request, in addition to delivery upon execution.

elements.evidence: The rendered clause requires Professional Liability (Errors and Omissions) Insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000.
